description: Main script for DU health check system; performs configuration loading, Kubernetes interactions, metrics collection, connectivity checks, report generation, and publishing results to Kafka and Loki.

methods.name: None _apply_overrides(cfg: AppConfig, site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Applies site_id, environment, and additional overrides to the AppConfig object.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_connectivity(cfg: AppConfig)
methods.description: Performs TCP connectivity checks to CU and RU endpoints defined in the configuration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _report_to_dict(report)
methods.description: Converts a health report dataclass instance into a dictionary structure.

methods.name: argparse.Namespace _parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: AppConfig _load_config(site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Loads configuration from files and environment, applies overrides.

methods.name: None _log_effective_config(logger: logging.Logger, cfg: AppConfig)
methods.description: Logs the effective configuration parameters at DEBUG level.

methods.name: _prepare_k8s(logger: logging.Logger, cfg: AppConfig)
methods.description: Prepares a Kubernetes API client, using simulator or real client based on config.

methods.name: _discover_cluster(logger: logging.Logger, core_api, cfg: AppConfig)
methods.description: Discovers nodes and pods in the Kubernetes cluster, using simulator or real client.

methods.name: _gather_metrics_and_connectivity(logger: logging.Logger, core_api, cfg: AppConfig, pods)
methods.description: Collects logs/metrics and performs connectivity checks.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_cli(site_id: Optional[str] = None, environment: Optional[str] = None, overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Main workflow function: loads config, prepares cluster, collects data, builds report.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Entry point for script execution, handles CLI args, orchestrates report publishing, and returns exit code.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_overrides_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace)
methods.description: Constructs configuration overrides from CLI arguments.

methods.name: None _push_loki_on_kafka_failure(cfg: AppConfig, logger: logging.Logger, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Publishes error info to Loki if Kafka publish fails.

methods.name: None _publish_to_kafka_safe(cfg: AppConfig, result: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger, also_push_loki: bool)
methods.description: Safely publishes report to Kafka, logs any errors, optionally push Loki logs on failure.

methods.name: None _append_anomaly_entries(entries: list, metrics: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Adds anomaly details from metrics to Loki entries list.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _summary_entry(result: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a summary Loki log entry for the report.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_loki_entries(result: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Builds a list of Loki log entries from the report.

ctags.name: _append_anomaly_entries
ctags.pattern: /^def _append_anomaly_entries(entries: list, metrics: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str]) -> N/
ctags.signature: (entries: list, metrics: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str])

ctags.name: _apply_overrides
ctags.pattern: /^def _apply_overrides(cfg: AppConfig, site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrid/
ctags.signature: (cfg: AppConfig, site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]])

ctags.name: _build_loki_entries
ctags.pattern: /^def _build_loki_entries(result: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: _load_config
ctags.signature: (site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]])

ctags.name: _publish_to_kafka_safe
ctags.pattern: /^def _publish_to_kafka_safe(cfg: AppConfig, result: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger, also_/
ctags.signature: (cfg: AppConfig, result: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger, also_push_loki: bool)

ctags.name: _push_loki_on_kafka_failure
ctags.pattern: /^def _push_loki_on_kafka_failure(cfg: AppConfig, logger: logging.Logger, exc: Exception) -> None:$/

ctags.name: _summary_entry
ctags.pattern: /^def _summary_entry(result: Dict[str, Any], site_id: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: kube_utils_mod
ctags.pattern: /^        import app.kube_utils as kube_utils_mod  # type: ignore$/

ctags.name: run_cli
ctags.pattern: /^def run_cli(site_id: Optional[str] = None, environment: Optional[str] = None, overrides: Optiona/
ctags.signature: (site_id: Optional[str] = None, environment: Optional[str] = None, overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
